meta.default_description: Kvikindi provides pest control for homes and businesses in Iceland: mice, rats, wasps and insects.

pages.thjonusta: Pest control for homes and businesses in Iceland: mice, rats, wasps and insects. Inspection, treatment and follow-up by licensed professionals.
pages.thjonusta_mys: Mice or rats in the house? Kvikindi finds where they get in, removes them and seals the entry points. For homes, summer houses and businesses.
pages.thjonusta_geitungar: Wasp nest under the eaves, in a wall or in the garden? Kvikindi removes wasp nests safely with the right equipment.
pages.thjonusta_skordyr: Bed bugs, cockroaches, silverfish and ants. Kvikindi identifies the species and chooses a treatment that suits the situation.
pages.thjonusta_fyrirtaeki: Regular pest monitoring and prevention for restaurants, shops, warehouses, hotels and housing associations.
pages.hafa_samband: Send Kvikindi a pest control request. Tell us what you have seen and where, and we will get back to you.
pages.um_okkur: Kvikindi pest control: operating licence from the health authority, user licences and recognised pest control training.
pages.meindyr: Common pests in Icelandic homes: mice, rats, wasps, bed bugs, cockroaches, silverfish, fleas and more. Signs to look for and when to get help.
pages.spurningar: Answers to common questions about pest control: mice and rats, wasps, insects and services for businesses.
